expectations.text: Sets master volume in $D418 / 54296 (low nibble, e.g. 15)
expectations.evidence: POKE S+24,15 with S=54272 → 54296=$D418, volume 15; asm LDA #$0F : STA $D418
POKE S,37 ($D400) and POKE S+1,17 ($D401); asm STA $D400 / STA $D401

expectations.text: Sets the voice 1 control register $D404 to a sawtooth+gate value (sawtooth bit 32 + gate 1 = 33)
expectations.evidence: POKE S+4,33 (S+4=$D404), sawtooth(32)+GATE(1)=33; asm LDA #$21 : STA $D404
POKE S+5,9 ($D405 attack/decay), POKE S+6,240 ($D406 sustain/release)

expectations.text: Clears the gate bit afterwards to release the note
expectations.evidence: POKE S+4,32 → GATE off, release phase; asm LDA #$20 : STA $D404
